# Data Processing Script

Purpose: Import raw data and create processed dataset

## Load the required package

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Load dataset from package

```{r}
penguins_raw <- palmerpenguins::penguins
```

## Save raw dataset

```{r}
write.csv(
  penguins_raw,
  "data/data_raw/penguins_raw.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Verify raw dataset

```{r}
raw_check <- read.csv("data/data_raw/penguins_raw.csv")

cat("Raw dataset dimensions:\n")
print(dim(raw_check))

cat("Raw dataset column names:\n")
print(colnames(raw_check))

cat("Missing values in raw dataset:\n")
print(sum(is.na(raw_check)))

```

Expected: 344 rows 8 columns 19 missing values

## Create Processed Dataset

```{r}
penguins_processed <- raw_check %>%
  select(
    species,
    flipper_length_mm,
    body_mass_g
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(species),
    !is.na(flipper_length_mm),
    !is.na(body_mass_g)
  )

```

## Verify processed data

```{r}
cat("Processed dataset dimensions:\n")
print(dim(penguins_processed))

cat("Missing values in processed dataset:\n")
print(sum(is.na(penguins_processed)))
```

Expected: 342 rows 3 columns 0 missing values

## Save processed data

```{r}
write.csv(
  penguins_processed,
  "data/data_processed/penguins_processed.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# End of Script
